description: Shared location validation, recovery/import UI and protected attachment transport bring measured core JavaScript to 290 KB gzip; reviewed ceiling 305 KB. On-demand PDF.js renderer/worker/decoders: 700 KB gzip (668 KB measured). All PDF assets including fonts/CMaps/wasm: 5 MB raw (4.77 MB measured). Every asset remains scanned and counted in total build bytes. These are regression ceilings, not latency guarantees.
